title: गृहमन्त्री गुरुङकी आमाको भिडिओ सार्वजनिक गर्ने छत्र बोगटी प्रहरी नियन्त्रणमा
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङको भिडिओ सार्वजनिक गर्ने एक युट्यूवरलाई प्रहरीले नियन्त्रणमा लिएको छ । कालीकोट घर भई भक्तपुर बस्ने छत्र बोगटीलाई भक्तपुरबाट पक्राउ गरिएको जिल्ला प्रहरी परिसर काठमाडौंका प्रवक्ता एसपी दानबहादुर थापाले बताए । उनलाई वैयक्तिक गोपनीयताको हक हनन गरेको कसुरमा काठमाडौं जिल्ला अदालतबाट ५ दिनको म्याद थप गरिएको छ । गुरुङकी ४९ वर्षीया आमा ज्ञानु लामा (ज्वालादेवी चण्डिमाता) ले आफ्नो अनुमतिबिना भिडिओ खिची सामाजिक सञ्जालमा सार्वजनिक गरेर गोपनीयता हनन गरेको भन्दै जिल्ला प्रहरी परिसर काठमाडौंमा निवेदन दिएकी थिइन् । सोही उजुरीका आधारमा पक्राउ गरिएको प्रहरी स्रोतले बतायो । लामो समयदेखि घरबार त्यागेर धार्मिक जीवन बिताउँदै आएकी लामाको भिडिओ केही दिनदेखि सामाजिक सञ्जालमा भाइरल भएको थियो । भिडिओमा उनले छोरा सुदनसितको सम्बन्धबारे अनौपचारिकरुपमा कुराकानी गरेको सुनिन्छ । आफ्नो दुई छोरी र एक छोरा भएको उनले बताएकी छन् । छोरा गृहमन्त्री भएपछि भेट नभएको र कहिलेकाही काम पर्दा छोराले फोन गर्ने गरेको उनको भनाइ छ । छोराले तपाईंलाई खर्चपर्च दिने गर्नुभएको छैन ? भन्ने प्रश्नमा उनले जवाफ दिएकी छन्, ‘मेरो हातखुट्टा सग्ला छन् । अहिले मलाई छोराछोरीको सहयोग चाहिएको छैन । साह्रै आपत पर्दा उनीहरुले सहयोग गर्ने हो ।’ लामाले आफ्नो विभिन्न आश्रममा बस्दै आएको बताएकी छन् । तर सडकमा मागेर खानुपर्ने अवस्था नभएको उनको भनाइ छ । छोरालाई भेट्न जानुहुन्न ? भन्ने प्रश्नमा उनले भनेकी छन्, ‘अहिले मेरो व्यवस्था मिलिसकेको छैन । व्यवस्था मिलेपछि भेट्न बोलाउँछु ।’ आफ्नो भिडिओ सामाजिक सञ्जालमा भाइरल भएपछि लामा आक्रोशित बनेकी थिइन् । उनले एउटा लामो भिडिओ सार्वजनिक गर्दै अनुमतिबिना लुकेर भिडिओ खिचिएको बताइन् । ‘मैले अन्तर्वार्ता लिन अनुमति दिएको थिइनँ । यत्तिकै गरेको कुराकानीलाई भिडिओ खिचेर भाइरल गरिएको रहेछ । उनीहरुमाथि कारवाही हुनुपर्छ । मलाई केही भयो भने उनीहरुले जिम्मेवारी लिनुपर्छ’ लामाले भनेकी छन् । पैसा कमाउनकै लागि कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा आँच आउने काम नगर्न उनको आग्रह छ । आफूलाई समाजसेवीसमेत बताउने लामाले भनेकी छन्, ‘कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनको कुरा प्लीज भाइरल नगर्नु । व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा यसले टर्चर हुन्छ । त्यो भिडिओ कतिबेला फोटो खिचियो मलाई थाहा छैन । बाटोमा हिँड्दा भेटेका व्यक्तिले भिडिओ खिचेर पैसा कमाउन भाइरल गरेछन् । यसरी बिनामिहिनेत पैसा कमाउन खोज्नु हुँदैन । सत्तामा गएपछि रिस डाहा गर्नेहरु धेरै हुन्छन् । उसलाई कसरी ढाल्ने भनेर लाग्छन् । आफ्नै देशको नागरिकलाई यसरी खेदो खन्नु हुँदैन । संसारलाई बचाउँ, हामी पनि बाँचौँ ।’ गृहमन्त्री निकट स्रोतका अनुसार उनी सानै हुँदा आमाले छोडेर हिँडेकी थिइन् । त्यसपछि उनलाई मावली परिवारले हुर्काएका थिए । पक्राउ परेका छत्र बोगटी (सर्विन) कलाकार पनि हुन् । उनी नेपाली लोक तथा देउडा गायक, संगीतकार र डिजिटल क्रिएटरका रूपमा परिचित छन् । उनले गायिका अञ्जु पन्तलगायतका कलाकारहरूसँग गीत गाएका छन् र आफ्नै युट्युव च्यानल मार्फत पनि सिर्जनाहरू सार्वजनिक गर्ने गर्छन् । Kathmandu. Police have taken into custody a YouTuber who made Home Minister Sudhan Gurung's video public. Chhatra Bogati, a native of Kalikot and resident of Bhaktapur, was arrested from Bhaktapur, said SP Dan Bahadur Thapa, spokesperson of the District Police Range, Kathmandu. He has been remanded in custody for five days by the Kathmandu District Court for violating his right to personal privacy. Gurung's 49-year-old mother Gyanu Lama (Jwaladevi Chandimata) had filed a complaint with the Kathmandu District Police Complex alleging that the video was filmed without her permission and posted on social media, violating her privacy. Police sources said that the arrest was based on the same complaint. A video of Lama, who has been living a religious life away from home for a long time, went viral on social media for a few days. In the video, she can be heard talking informally about her relationship with her son Sudan. She has said that she has two daughters and a son. She says that she has not met him since his son became the Home Minister and that his son calls her occasionally when he has work to do. When asked if her son has been providing her with any financial support, she replied, "My hands and feet are fine. I don't need my children's help right now. They will help me in times of great need." The Lama said that he has been living in various ashrams, but he says that he has not had to beg for food on the streets. When asked if she would like to meet her son, she said, "I haven't made any arrangements yet. I will call you to meet me once I have made arrangements." Lama was furious after her video went viral on social media. She released a long video, saying that the video was secretly filmed without permission. "I did not give permission for the interview. The conversation I had was recorded on video and went viral. Action should be taken against them. If anything happens to me, they should take responsibility," Lama said. He urges people not to do anything that could jeopardize someone's personal life just to make money. Lama, who also calls herself a social worker, said, 'Please don't go viral about someone's personal life. It causes torture in personal life. I don't know when that video was taken. People who met while walking on the road took videos and made them viral to earn money. You shouldn't try to earn money without working hard like this. There are many people who get angry after coming to power. They think about how to overthrow them. You shouldn't persecute the citizens of your own country like this. Let's save the world, let's also live.' According to sources close to the Home Minister, her mother abandoned her when she was young. She was then raised by the Mavali family. The arrested Chhatra Bogati (Sarvin) is also an artist. He is known as a Nepali folk and Deuda singer, musician and digital creator. He has sung songs with artists including singer Anju Pant and also publishes his creations through his own YouTube channel.

भन्ने प्रश्नमा उनले जवाफ दिएकी छन्, ‘मेरो हातखुट्टा सग्ला छन् । अहिले मलाई छोराछोरीको सहयोग चाहिएको छैन । साह्रै आपत पर्दा उनीहरुले सहयोग गर्ने हो ।’ लामाले आफ्नो विभिन्न आश्रममा बस्दै आएको बताएकी छन् । तर सडकमा मागेर खानुपर्ने अवस्था नभएको उनको भनाइ छ । छोरालाई भेट्न जानुहुन्न ? भन्ने प्रश्नमा उनले भनेकी छन्, ‘अहिले मेरो व्यवस्था मिलिसकेको छैन । व्यवस्था मिलेपछि भेट्न बोलाउँछु ।’ आफ्नो भिडिओ सामाजिक सञ्जालमा भाइरल भएपछि लामा आक्रोशित बनेकी थिइन् । उनले एउटा लामो भिडिओ सार्वजनिक गर्दै अनुमतिबिना लुकेर भिडिओ खिचिएको बताइन् । ‘मैले अन्तर्वार्ता लिन अनुमति दिएको थिइनँ । यत्तिकै गरेको कुराकानीलाई भिडिओ खिचेर भाइरल गरिएको रहेछ । उनीहरुमाथि कारवाही हुनुपर्छ । मलाई केही भयो भने उनीहरुले जिम्मेवारी लिनुपर्छ’ लामाले भनेकी छन् । पैसा कमाउनकै लागि कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा आँच आउने काम नगर्न उनको आग्रह छ । आफूलाई समाजसेवीसमेत बताउने लामाले भनेकी छन्, ‘कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनको कुरा प्लीज भाइरल नगर्नु । व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा यसले टर्चर हुन्छ । त्यो भिडिओ कतिबेला फोटो खिचियो मलाई थाहा छैन । बाटोमा हिँड्दा भेटेका व्यक्तिले भिडिओ खिचेर पैसा कमाउन भाइरल गरेछन् । यसरी बिनामिहिनेत पैसा कमाउन खोज्नु हुँदैन । सत्तामा गएपछि रिस डाहा गर्नेहरु धेरै हुन्छन् । उसलाई कसरी ढाल्ने भनेर लाग्छन् । आफ्नै देशको नागरिकलाई यसरी खेदो खन्नु हुँदैन । संसारलाई बचाउँ, हामी पनि बाँचौँ ।’ गृहमन्त्री निकट स्रोतका अनुसार उनी सानै हुँदा आमाले छोडेर हिँडेकी थिइन् । त्यसपछि उनलाई मावली परिवारले हुर्काएका थिए । पक्राउ परेका छत्र बोगटी (सर्विन) कलाकार पनि हुन् । उनी नेपाली लोक तथा देउडा गायक, संगीतकार र डिजिटल क्रिएटरका रूपमा परिचित छन् । उनले गायिका अञ्जु पन्तलगायतका कलाकारहरूसँग गीत गाएका छन् र आफ्नै युट्युव च्यानल मार्फत पनि सिर्जनाहरू सार्वजनिक गर्ने गर्छन् । Kathmandu. Police have taken into custody a YouTuber who made Home Minister Sudhan Gurung's video public. Chhatra Bogati, a native of Kalikot and resident of Bhaktapur, was arrested from Bhaktapur, said SP Dan Bahadur Thapa, spokesperson of the District Police Range, Kathmandu. He has been remanded in custody for five days by the Kathmandu District Court for violating his right to personal privacy. Gurung's 49-year-old mother Gyanu Lama (Jwaladevi Chandimata) had filed a complaint with the Kathmandu District Police Complex alleging that the video was filmed without her permission and posted on social media, violating her privacy. Police sources said that the arrest was based on the same complaint. A video of Lama, who has been living a religious life away from home for a long time, went viral on social media for a few days. In the video, she can be heard talking informally about her relationship with her son Sudan. She has said that she has two daughters and a son. She says that she has not met him since his son became the Home Minister and that his son calls her occasionally when he has work to do. When asked if her son has been providing her with any financial support, she replied, "My hands and feet are fine. I don't need my children's help right now. They will help me in times of great need." The Lama said that he has been living in various ashrams, but he says that he has not had to beg for food on the streets. When asked if she would like to meet her son, she said, "I haven't made any arrangements yet. I will call you to meet me once I have made arrangements." Lama was furious after her video went viral on social media. She released a long video, saying that the video was secretly filmed without permission. "I did not give permission for the interview. The conversation I had was recorded on video and went viral. Action should be taken against them. If anything happens to me, they should take responsibility," Lama said. He urges people not to do anything that could jeopardize someone's personal life just to make money. Lama, who also calls herself a social worker, said, 'Please don't go viral about someone's personal life. It causes torture in personal life. I don't know when that video was taken. People who met while walking on the road took videos and made them viral to earn money. You shouldn't try to earn money without working hard like this. There are many people who get angry after coming to power. They think about how to overthrow them. You shouldn't persecute the citizens of your own country like this. Let's save the world, let's also live.' According to sources close to the Home Minister, her mother abandoned her when she was young. She was then raised by the Mavali family. The arrested Chhatra Bogati (Sarvin) is also an artist. He is known as a Nepali folk and Deuda singer, musician and digital creator. He has sung songs with artists including singer Anju Pant and also publishes his creations through his own YouTube channel.

Police have taken into custody a YouTuber who made Home Minister Sudhan Gurung's video public. Chhatra Bogati, a native of Kalikot and resident of Bhaktapur, was arrested from Bhaktapur, said SP Dan Bahadur Thapa, spokesperson of the District Police Range, Kathmandu. He has been remanded in custody for five days by the Kathmandu District Court for violating his right to personal privacy. Gurung's 49-year-old mother Gyanu Lama (Jwaladevi Chandimata) had filed a complaint with the Kathmandu District Police Complex alleging that the video was filmed without her permission and posted on social media, violating her privacy. Police sources said that the arrest was based on the same complaint. A video of Lama, who has been living a religious life away from home for a long time, went viral on social media for a few days. In the video, she can be heard talking informally about her relationship with her son Sudan. She has said that she has two daughters and a son. She says that she has not met him since his son became the Home Minister and that his son calls her occasionally when he has work to do. When asked if her son has been providing her with any financial support, she replied, "My hands and feet are fine. I don't need my children's help right now. They will help me in times of great need." The Lama said that he has been living in various ashrams, but he says that he has not had to beg for food on the streets. When asked if she would like to meet her son, she said, "I haven't made any arrangements yet. I will call you to meet me once I have made arrangements." Lama was furious after her video went viral on social media. She released a long video, saying that the video was secretly filmed without permission. "I did not give permission for the interview. The conversation I had was recorded on video and went viral. Action should be taken against them. If anything happens to me, they should take responsibility," Lama said. He urges people not to do anything that could jeopardize someone's personal life just to make money. Lama, who also calls herself a social worker, said, 'Please don't go viral about someone's personal life. It causes torture in personal life. I don't know when that video was taken. People who met while walking on the road took videos and made them viral to earn money. You shouldn't try to earn money without working hard like this. There are many people who get angry after coming to power. They think about how to overthrow them. You shouldn't persecute the citizens of your own country like this. Let's save the world, let's also live.' According to sources close to the Home Minister, her mother abandoned her when she was young. She was then raised by the Mavali family. The arrested Chhatra Bogati (Sarvin) is also an artist. He is known as a Nepali folk and Deuda singer, musician and digital creator. He has sung songs with artists including singer Anju Pant and also publishes his creations through his own YouTube channel.

पैसा कमाउनकै लागि कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा आँच आउने काम नगर्न उनको आग्रह छ ।

आफूलाई समाजसेवीसमेत बताउने लामाले भनेकी छन्, ‘कसैको व्यक्तिगत जीवनको कुरा प्लीज भाइरल नगर्नु । व्यक्तिगत जीवनमा यसले टर्चर हुन्छ । त्यो भिडिओ कतिबेला फोटो खिचियो मलाई थाहा छैन । बाटोमा हिँड्दा भेटेका व्यक्तिले भिडिओ खिचेर पैसा कमाउन भाइरल गरेछन् । यसरी बिनामिहिनेत पैसा कमाउन खोज्नु हुँदैन । सत्तामा गएपछि रिस डाहा गर्नेहरु धेरै हुन्छन् । उसलाई कसरी ढाल्ने भनेर लाग्छन् । आफ्नै देशको नागरिकलाई यसरी खेदो खन्नु हुँदैन । संसारलाई बचाउँ, हामी पनि बाँचौँ ।’

गृहमन्त्री निकट स्रोतका अनुसार उनी सानै हुँदा आमाले छोडेर हिँडेकी थिइन् । त्यसपछि उनलाई मावली परिवारले हुर्काएका थिए ।

पक्राउ परेका छत्र बोगटी (सर्विन) कलाकार पनि हुन् । उनी नेपाली लोक तथा देउडा गायक, संगीतकार र डिजिटल क्रिएटरका रूपमा परिचित छन् । उनले गायिका अञ्जु पन्तलगायतका कलाकारहरूसँग गीत गाएका छन् र आफ्नै युट्युव च्यानल मार्फत पनि सिर्जनाहरू सार्वजनिक गर्ने गर्छन् ।

Chhatra Bogati, a native of Kalikot and resident of Bhaktapur, was arrested from Bhaktapur, said SP Dan Bahadur Thapa, spokesperson of the District Police Range, Kathmandu. He has been remanded in custody for five days by the Kathmandu District Court for violating his right to personal privacy. Gurung's 49-year-old mother Gyanu Lama (Jwaladevi Chandimata) had filed a complaint with the Kathmandu District Police Complex alleging that the video was filmed without her permission and posted on social media, violating her privacy. Police sources said that the arrest was based on the same complaint. A video of Lama, who has been living a religious life away from home for a long time, went viral on social media for a few days. In the video, she can be heard talking informally about her relationship with her son Sudan. She has said that she has two daughters and a son. She says that she has not met him since his son became the Home Minister and that his son calls her occasionally when he has work to do. When asked if her son has been providing her with any financial support, she replied, "My hands and feet are fine. I don't need my children's help right now. They will help me in times of great need." The Lama said that he has been living in various ashrams, but he says that he has not had to beg for food on the streets. When asked if she would like to meet her son, she said, "I haven't made any arrangements yet. I will call you to meet me once I have made arrangements." Lama was furious after her video went viral on social media. She released a long video, saying that the video was secretly filmed without permission. "I did not give permission for the interview. The conversation I had was recorded on video and went viral. Action should be taken against them. If anything happens to me, they should take responsibility," Lama said. He urges people not to do anything that could jeopardize someone's personal life just to make money. Lama, who also calls herself a social worker, said, 'Please don't go viral about someone's personal life. It causes torture in personal life. I don't know when that video was taken. People who met while walking on the road took videos and made them viral to earn money. You shouldn't try to earn money without working hard like this. There are many people who get angry after coming to power. They think about how to overthrow them. You shouldn't persecute the citizens of your own country like this. Let's save the world, let's also live.' According to sources close to the Home Minister, her mother abandoned her when she was young. She was then raised by the Mavali family. The arrested Chhatra Bogati (Sarvin) is also an artist. He is known as a Nepali folk and Deuda singer, musician and digital creator. He has sung songs with artists including singer Anju Pant and also publishes his creations through his own YouTube channel.
